ideal.label: Ideal Gaussian head-on monochromatization factor
ideal.scope: static evaluated-optics reference; not a frame or luminosity-weighted measurement

definition.model: independent Gaussian input energies and horizontal betatron coordinates; head-on spatial overlap; first-order invariant-mass width
definition.meaning: Ideal 1 means no dispersion-selection narrowing. Measured width ratio >1 means narrower than the nominal input reference; <1 means broader.
definition.frame_resolution_rule: Positive luminosity, zero under/overflow, at least two positive-weight bins, and estimated RMS at least the widest positive-weight bin width.
limitations: Evaluated out.dat parameters retain native printed rounding; sigma_x is interpreted as the configured pre-dispersion betatron size, not a measurement of loaded particles.
The ideal factor omits crossing, hourglass, collective fields, beamstrahlung, angular spread and equilibrium changes; zero dispersion returns reference1 even for a non-head-on actual run.
Input-width reference is an independent head-on first-order approximation. The observed spectrum includes native collision effects; this ratio does not isolate dispersion gain.
Full RMS is tail-sensitive and is not a Gaussian core fit. Frame bin-center estimates omit within-bin variance and require the stated resolution rule.
Total is formed from the integrated spectrum; it is not an average of frame ratios. No independent-seed uncertainty is inferred.

references.title: Valdivia Garcia and Zimmermann, The challenge of monochromatization (2021)

peak_fit.estimator: bin-integrated beta-delta Gaussian convolution density least-squares shape fit; nonnegative component amplitudes profiled
peak_fit.model: Wilson Appendix A.1 beta distribution plus delta at x=1, convolved with a Gaussian response

nominal_reference.native_W: Existing massive invariant mass of native simulated incoming directions; no design crossing rotation; beam energies before optional ISR sampling

verification_tolerance.optimizer_counts: recorded provenance; not a cross-platform equality condition

fit_source.selection: all exported native bins; no rebinning; flow must be zero

peak_fit.objective: sum((p_i-A*q_i)^2/bin_width_i)/sum(p_i^2/bin_width_i); p_i=L_i/sum(L); Gaussian and beta-convolved component amplitudes profiled by nonnegative least squares
peak_fit.normalization: model_area_native is the fitted full-real-line mixture area in native m^-2 per BX; fitted bin luminosity=area*mixture_bin_probability
peak_fit.scope: Full informative luminosity spectrum determines beta tail; native W>=0.98 nominal diagnostic averages remain separate and unchanged; total fit is not an average of frame fits
peak_fit.statistical_interpretation: Descriptive weighted shape fit; no Poisson-count assumption, p-value, parameter statistical uncertainty, or causal matched-control gain

quadrature.method: Gauss-Legendre after x^alpha / (1-x)^beta endpoint substitutions; exact Gaussian CDF bin integrals
